18:def _locate_lines(source_text: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, int]]:
19:    tree = ast.parse(source_text)
20:    out: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
21:    for node in tree.body:
22:        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in {"trapz", "cumulative_trapezoid"}:
23:            start = node.body[0].lineno
24:            target = None
25:            for child in ast.walk(node):
26:                if isinstance(child, ast.Assign):
27:                    if any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == "x_sl1" for t in child.targets):
28:                        target = child.lineno
29:                        break
30:            if target is None:
31:                raise ValueError(f"Could not find x_sl1 assignment in {node.name}.")
32:            out[node.name] = {"start": start, "target": target}
33:    if set(out) != {"trapz", "cumulative_trapezoid"}:
34:        raise ValueError("Missing trapz/cumulative_trapezoid line mapping.")
35:    return out

38:def extract_invariant(trace_text: str, source_text: str) -> dict[str, object]:
39:    lines = _locate_lines(source_text)
40:    current_axis: dict[str, int | None] = {"trapz": None, "cumulative_trapezoid": None}

47:        elif func_full.endswith(".cumulative_trapezoid"):
48:            fn = "cumulative_trapezoid"

53:        locals_map = ast.literal_eval(m.group("locals"))
